fusions.name: Night Drone
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stings at once, spread apart, each dealing 2 dark damage, with a 25% chance per hit to leave the target [Blunted], its critical hit chance lowered, for 4 seconds. [Blunted] is catching: it passes to up to 2 more enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Pulse in the Dark
fusions.desc: Fires a sting that deals 24 damage to the first enemy it reaches, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Flitting Cloud
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 10 seconds. A swarm fights beside you for 11 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Wingbeat Tempo
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 8. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
